analyst_view.overall: Como are 4th on 9 points in their first Champions League season, including a 9-1 win at Lens. AEK are 29th on 3 points after four defeats in five games. Como have lost Moise Kean for 'a few months': Fabregas confirmed on 20 November that the injury got worse after international duty. Kean is not on the numbers' missing list, and Tasos Douvikas is now Como's only proven striker. Assane Diao and Jesús Rodríguez are also out for Como, while Tchaloba returns. AEK are without Aboubakary Koita, banned for two games by UEFA after his red card against Real Madrid; the numbers already take about 17% off AEK's goals for that. No referee has been named.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals and do not know that Kean is out for months. Without their main striker, Como are left with Douvikas and no other recognised centre-forward, after a run of 19 goals in six games that the numbers already ride (+7%). Koita's ban is already counted for AEK. I go to about 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners, with Como around 5.7. Losing Kean changes who finishes moves more than how often Como push down the flanks, and both sides' recent corner counts are already in (small momentum dips). I stay at 9.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards and already take about 15% off Como's side for how few cards they have picked up lately. AEK, chasing points and missing Koita after his red card, could get edgy, but that is a hunch rather than news. No referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.2 shots. Without Kean, Como lose a striker who shoots often, and Douvikas would have to play every minute. AEK's shooting without Koita is already partly reflected through his removal from the goals. I trim to about 25.4.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.5 shots on target, with Como's sharp recent finishing counted (+2%). Kean's absence takes away a lot of Como's threat in the box, so I go a little lower, to about 9.0.
